Staff-led7plates is not a discount from chef’s10plates. Cached September27special ignored. Six-plate lunch restricted to non-holiday weekdays; ordinary courses exclude November15.

Agnel d’or official JS gallery inspected via rendered browser and booking/gallery links. Three own MICHELIN-credited images selected; four recommendation images of other venues rejected. September2026branch drinks-menu photograph transcribed only where legible; unclear wine lines and stock/prices remain for reconfirmation. Current dishes from operator-linked TableCheck, not the differing Septembervisit.

ad hoc original HTTP operator pages accessible; HTTPS502and Tabelogplaincurl403 recorded. Current managed booking plans and operator-linked MyConciergeJapan accessible via opened pages. Official homepage background was also downloaded and visually checked: it is a botanical landscape, not the restaurant, so it was excluded from venue photos.
